svg.title: Fuxi processor datapath
svg.desc: Single-issue, in-order RV32IMAC processor with Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory and Writeback stages. DefaultConfig sizes are shown. Fetch buffers four words, assembles 16/32-bit instructions and predicts with gshare, a BTB and a RAS. A two-entry IF/ID FIFO precedes compressed expansion and branch resolution in Decode. Decode corrections are registered. ID/EX, EX/MEM and MEM/WB use MidStage registers. EX contains the ALU, address adder, multiplier, divider and CSR read path. MEM handles loads, stores, multi-step AMOs, LR/SC checks, fences and traps. Load data comes directly from CoreBus to WB for alignment and extension, alongside MEM/WB metadata. EX, MEM and WB forward register results to Decode through HazardResolver. Load and CSR dependencies stall the pipeline. WB commits registers, CSRs and the local exclusive monitor. CSR reads and reservation checks pass through the resolver. PipelineController arbitrates stalls and redirects. PerformanceEvents gathers core and bus events. Separate instruction and data Sv32 MMUs each contain a 16-entry TLB and page walker. Walkers share their side's memory path with demand accesses. The I-cache is 4 KiB, direct mapped, with inst AXI. Data routes to an 8 KiB direct-mapped write-back, write-allocate cache and data AXI, or a single-beat uncached AXI adapter. Both caches have 64-byte lines and blocking miss handling. Matching I, D, R and C tags join split paths. Response wiring and control fan-out are summarized. This is a module-level datapath, not a cycle timing diagram.
svg.text: RV32IMAC + Zicsr + Zifencei · single issue · in-order execution · DefaultConfig sizes

g.text: Inputs: load / CSR hazards, EX / MEM stalls, traps, fences and committed SATP writes
Redirect priority: MEM trap / xRET → WB SATP → MEM fence → registered ID correction
IF/ID FIFO: flow=true · pipe=false · registered readiness
Two read ports · one WB write port
EX / MEM / WB forwarding → ID operands
CSR read path · WB reservation forwarding → MEM check
WB set / clear · global flush clears
WB commits: GPR data / CSR operation / reservation update
PerformanceEvents: pipeline + predictor + CoreBus → registered events → CsrFile · cycle / instret + 8 programmable HPM counters
CoreBus · address translation and memory interfaces
Blocking caches · 64-byte lines · three independent 32-bit AXI master ports
Fetch VA request / instruction words + faults
Current privilege · execute permission · software A/D bits
Instruction page-table reads also use the I-cache and inst AXI.
Return status / faults + AMO read data
Data privilege: MPRV / SUM / MXR · load / store / AMO permissions
Demand / page-walk select → cached / uncached route
Demand and data page-walk requests share this routing path.
Matching I / D / R / C tags join split paths. Response wiring and control fan-out are summarized; CSR reads pass through HazardResolver.
Module-level view · ID/EX, EX/MEM and MEM/WB use MidStage registers · Configurable capacities shown for DefaultConfig
